d: Watch an engaging and thought-provoking conversation with Vikramaditya Motwane on ‘Select Conversations with Tisca Chopra’. In this episode, Motwane reflects on his journey in cinema, the lessons that shaped him as a filmmaker, and the art of telling stories that leave a lasting impact. From his early days in the industry to creating acclaimed films like Udaan, Lootera, Sacred Games, and Black Warrant, he shares insights on creativity, ambition, filmmaking, and the evolving relationship between storytellers and audiences.
